gaps.sentence: There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
The council rejected plans for a new ___ (DEVELOP).
gaps.explanation: 'A development' = a building project; 'developer' = the company.

gaps.sentence: There's a growing ___ (AWARE) of mental health issues.
She gazed at the mural in silent ___ (ADMIRE).
gaps.explanation: 'In silent admiration' — the noun for the feeling.

gaps.sentence: Last night's ___ (PERFORM) ended with a standing ovation.
gaps.explanation: 'Last night's performance' — the noun for the event.
